name: MAF bZIP transcription factor
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MAF encodes transcription factor Maf. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and sequence-specific double-stranded DNA binding. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Ayme-Gripp syndrome (autosomal dominant); cataract 21 multiple types (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Plasma cell myeloma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
